records.description_rewritten: An old public toilet at the edge of Volkspark Wilmersdorf is carried by Planet Randy and CruisingGays. Planet Randy names Am Volkspark while CruisingGays gives Uhlandstraße 110 near U Blissestraße and Schoelerpark, plausibly an adjacent or alternate toilet site within the larger area; confirm they refer to the same facility before importing coordinates. CruisingGays says toilets are locked late at night, contradicting Planet Randy's undated claim of 24-hour activity. Neither website provides a dated 2026 visit.

supplemental_source_evidence.note: Original named public WC; editorial undated crowd and 24-hour claims.
Second directory; Uhlandstraße 110, notes locked overnight, but no dated current report.
Third gay-directory archive references Volkspark Wilmersdorf toilet at Am Volkspark/Ecke Livländische Straße; exact match uncertain.

records.access_information: Managed public WC subject to unknown maintenance and closures; CruisingGays describes nighttime closure. Public park paths are separate.
possible_duplicates_and_flags: Potential two separate WC sites on Volkspark Wilmersdorf boundary; verify addresses.
Planet Randy 24-hour wording conflicts with CruisingGays closing warning.

records.description_rewritten: The Sandgrube im Jagen 86 is a particular former sand quarry and nature-restoration site in Grunewald, not the separate sandy Jagen 87 clearing (index 662) or Jagen 90 (index 637). Planet Randy claims informal naturist sunbathing and cruising on the sand but has no dated user reviews. Its generic crowd/seasonal statements are not proven current, and the nearby wetland restoration area requires conservation caution.

supplemental_source_evidence.note: Original detail, no dated visitor reviews and distinct Jagen 86 location.

records.access_information: Protected sand-quarry landscape and wet biotope, with public paths limited by posted habitat protection; do not enter fenced restoration habitat.
possible_duplicates_and_flags: Keep Jagen 86 separate from Jagen 87 (#662) and Jagen 90 (#637).
Naturist claims are not lawful public-sex authorisation.

records.description_rewritten: The Planet Randy parking-lot entry describes parking near S-Bahnhof Grunewald and footpaths between a tree nursery and old sports ground, corresponding closely to the previously recorded 'Grunewald' candidate GS2-DE-BERLIN-012 (#636). The park's general identity is secure, but this exact Pappelplatz/parking subarea should be spatially compared rather than assumed identical to Jagen 87/90 or an A115 motorway rest area. Four dated user reviews from June 2022 through April 2025 include first-person cruising claims, none within the 12-month cutoff. The April 2025 account is extremely elaborate and uncorroborated; do not use it for crowd estimates.

supplemental_source_evidence.note: Original 4 reviews dated 2022, 2023, 2025; older than cutoff.
Earlier #636 source uses Pappelplatz and tree nursery/old sports ground matching this parking lead.

older_dated_posts.note: Long sexual anecdote with no independent corroboration; pre-cutoff.

records.access_information: Public/managed parking near S Grunewald with pedestrian forest paths; no permission for sex or parking outside normal regulations.
possible_duplicates_and_flags: Distinct from motorway rest stops and separate Jagen 86–90 sites.

records.description_rewritten: Bad am Spreewaldplatz, officially Wellenbad am Spreewaldplatz at Wiener Straße 59H in Kreuzberg, is a public family wave pool with sauna. The original gay-szene directory historically labels it as a cruising location, but Berliner Bäder-Betriebe confirms it has been CLOSED since autumn 2023 for complete renovation. A 2026 district update and the operator's September 2026 works bulletin show the facility still being rebuilt; no access, swimming, or cruising is possible there now. Preserve the research entry with closure and zero recent use.

supplemental_source_evidence.note: Archived named cruising lead, historical only.
Operator states bath and sauna closed during comprehensive renovation.
Official 4 June 2026 update confirms extensive works ongoing.

records.access_information: Closed construction site; no public access to pools, changing rooms, sauna or building. Do not enter works site.
possible_duplicates_and_flags: Strong official evidence of closure in November 2026; hold for later reopened status.
Historical gay directory must not be treated as operating venue.

records.description_rewritten: This archive record names the McFIT Berlin-Wedding gym in Forum Seestraße 64, not the separate McFIT Wilmersdorf or any other Berlin studio. The original gay-szene directory describes claimed cruising at its old entrance but does not establish lawful use or recent activity. Crucially McFIT's own help centre says this specific branch CLOSED on 17 August 2026 for refurbishment, and the official studio page currently marks it temporarily closed. External listings also indicate reopening is pending, so no visitor should be directed to it in November 2026.

supplemental_source_evidence.note: Original claimed cruising record at Seestraße 64.
Operator reports closure from 17 August 2026 for renovation.
Official studio page marks location temporarily closed.
Secondary listing confirms Seestraße 64 and closed in October/November 2026.

records.access_information: Membership gym closed for construction as of 6 November 2026. Changing rooms and entry inaccessible; not a designated cruising venue.
possible_duplicates_and_flags: Official gym closure overrides undated directory description.
Do not mix with McFIT Wilmersdorf or other branches.
